adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/best.html.erb the header conditional is closed with `<%- end if %>` instead of `<%- end %>`. This introduces an `end if` modifier with no inline condition; depending on ERB compilation it can either be a Ruby syntax error at render time or unintentionally bind the next generated Ruby expression (the logo link output) as the modifier condition, altering header output/control flow. Either way this is a real defect in the diff.
